records.title: Emergency Department Discharge Summary
records.text: Chief concern: persistent cough and fever for four days. Discharged with supportive-care instructions. Return precautions reviewed.

records.title: Basic Metabolic Panel
records.text: Sodium 139 mmol/L. Potassium 4.1 mmol/L. Creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, flagged high by the reporting laboratory.

records.title: Chest X-ray Report
records.text: Portable chest radiograph. Mild left basilar opacity is described. No pleural effusion reported. Correlate clinically.
